subject: Hosted API billing workflow and invoicing path selection
messages:
From: Sara Jenkins <sara.jenkins@acme.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T09:12:11-05:00
Subject: Hosted API billing workflow & invoicing options

Hi Ben,

We're wrapping up procurement for the pilot and need to lock down the billing path for the hosted API. Two quick questions:

1) Do you support monthly invoicing (Net 30) for hosted API customers, or is card on-file required for all Hosted customers?
2) If invoicing is possible, is there a minimum monthly commit and what documentation do you need (PO, signed SOW, billing contact)?

Also please send the baseline rate card for hosted API (token rates, embedding rates, and any volume tiers) so we can model costs into our SOW. We're evaluating paying by card during pilot vs switching to invoiced monthly for production.

Thanks — we need to present options to finance by end of day Friday.

Sara Jenkins
Procurement, ACME Corporation
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Sara Jenkins <sara.jenkins@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T11:03:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API billing workflow & invoicing options

Hi Sara — thanks for the clear ask. TL;DR: we support both card-on-file and monthly invoicing; invoicing requires a minimum onboarding and a short commerce intake. Details below so you have everything to pass to finance.

Options we offer for Hosted API customers:

- Card on File (self-serve):
  - Fastest path (immediate provisioning).
  - No minimum. Charges billed daily/weekly to card.
  - Recommended for pilots or small, variable usage.

- Monthly Invoicing (Net 30):
  - Available for customers with an expected monthly spend >= $5,000 (can be aggregated across teams).
  - Requires: PO referencing the Redwood quote, billing contact, and a signed MSA/Order Form.
  - Payment terms: Net 30 by default. We can accept ACH/Wire.
  - Invoice cadence: monthly in arrears (issued on 1st business day of month for prior month usage) — we can align to calendar month if needed.

Discounts & credits:
  - Volume tiering on hosted token/embedding rates (rate card attached).
  - We can extend a provisional onboarding credit (one-time) or a small introductory discount for a 12-month committed path — subject to deal desk approval.

Attachments I've included: 20261129-Ratecard-HostedAPI-v2.pdf (baseline rates & tiers) and RDW-Proposal-ACME-2026-11.pdf (a draft quote).

Next steps I recommend:
  1) Tell me whether finance prefers card or invoice.
  2) If invoice, share the PO # and billing contact and we'll route to our Finance Ops to open the invoicing account.
  3) If you'd like a committed discount or onboarding credit, say so and I'll loop in Marissa (cc'd) for commercial approval.

Happy to hop on a 15-min call if that helps move this faster.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

Ben — quick internal note before we confirm with ACME.

- ACME looks like a 50k ARR opportunity if we convert pilot. Offering monthly invoicing helps remove procurement friction.
- Recommend: Offer Net 30 invoicing with a one-time onboarding credit equal to 10% of first three months' committed usage (to help their consumption ramp).
- Ask Finance (Hannah) to confirm that we can onboard with PO and Net 30 (finance ticket FIN-4621). Also confirm whether we need a signed Order Form for invoiced customers under $100k ARR.

If Finance greenlights, I'll mark the quote with a one-line concession and get approval from Deals Desk.

Thanks — Marissa

Marissa — finance can support Net 30 invoicing for ACME. Notes:

- Minimum operational threshold: we require a billing intake (billing contact + PO) and 1 month of usage run rate to validate forecast.
- PO handling: please ask ACME to include our quote number on PO (RDW-QUOTE-7821).
- Credit: we can approve the one-time onboarding credit (10% for first 3 months) as a non-recurring concession; request submitted (FIN-4621).
- Collections: invoices are produced monthly; default payment terms are Net 30. If a customer prefers payment on the 1st of month, we can align invoice issue date to match.

Will update FIN ticket when the PO lands.

— Hannah (Finance Operations)
